articles.title_original: Ex-prosecutor charged with treason in Mexico over US drug raid
articles.title_zh: Ex-prosecutor charged with treason in Mexico over US drug raid
facts_zh:
Ex-prosecutor charged with treason in Mexico over US drug raid
- Published
Federal prosecutors in Mexico have charged a former state prosecutor with treason for allowing US agents to join a raid on a suspected drugs lab in April without proper authorisation.
César Jáuregui Moreno served as attorney general of the northern border state of Chihuahua from 2023 to this year.
The involvement of Americans came to light after two US agents said to have worked for the CIA died in a car crash in Chihuahua along with two Mexican law enforcement officers.

all_titles.en: Ex-prosecutor charged with treason in Mexico over US drug raid

articles.title_original: Pope does not need further treatment after lung cancer surgery
articles.title_zh: Pope does not need further treatment after lung cancer surgery
facts_zh:
Pope does not need further treatment after lung cancer surgery
- Published
Pope Leo XIV does not need any further treatment following an operation to remove a cancerous growth from his lung, his doctors have said.

Test results on tissue removed during surgery confirmed he had had a lung adenocarcinoma, as was initially diagnosed, and that the disease was localised, according to a statement shared by the Vatican.
"A subsequent oncological assessment has confirmed that no further treatment is necessary," it added.

all_titles.en: Pope does not need further treatment after lung cancer surgery

articles.title_original: Rosenberg: US diplomatic push offers little hope for imminent Ukraine peace
articles.title_zh: Rosenberg: US diplomatic push offers little hope for imminent Ukraine peace
facts_zh:
Rosenberg: US diplomatic push offers little hope for imminent Ukraine peace
- Published
After two days of diplomacy – in Norway's capital and Russia's St Petersburg – is the war in Ukraine any closer to ending?

"Good and constructive" is how Norway's prime minister described Tuesday's talks between Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky, US President Trump's special envoy Steve Witkoff and European representatives.
In Oslo, the idea of a trilateral meeting at leaders' level was floated.

all_titles.en: Rosenberg: US diplomatic push offers little hope for imminent Ukraine peace

- Published
Two leaders of the Gen Z-led Cockroach Janta Party (CJP) have been freed from jail a week after they were arrested for trespassing at a banned protest site in Delhi.
Saurav Das and Ashutosh Ranka walked out of Tihar jail hours after a magistrate ordered their release.
They had been detained by police and jailed after they crossed barricades and climbed over the locked gate at Jantar Mantar.

articles.title_original: Family of prison officer killed by IRA receives state apology
articles.title_zh: Family of prison officer killed by IRA receives state apology
facts_zh:
Family of prison officer killed by IRA receives state apology
- Published
The family of a senior Irish prison officer murdered by the IRA has received a state apology on Wednesday for failings in investigations into his killing.
Brian Stack, a father of three, was crossing a street in Dublin, after leaving a boxing match in 1983, when he was shot in the back of the neck.
Stack, who was the chief prison officer at the high-security Portlaoise Prison, was left paralysed and died 18 months later, aged 49.

all_titles.en: Family of prison officer killed by IRA receives state apology

articles.title_original: Macron accuses foreign leaders of exploiting French riots
articles.title_zh: Macron accuses foreign leaders of exploiting French riots
facts_zh:
Macron accuses foreign leaders of exploiting French riots
- Published
French President Emmanuel Macron has accused foreign leaders of exploiting the riots which erupted across the country on Saturday for electoral purposes.
Without naming them, he said they were campaigning for forthcoming elections "at France's expense" with their comments on the violence, which erupted on the fringe of cost-of-living protests.
Speaking on a visit to the Middle East, he referred to them as "leaders who are in campaign mode, whether here in the region or on the other side of the Atlantic".

all_titles.en: Macron accuses foreign leaders of exploiting French riots
